 114:         # state lock is released; revocation itself already took effect above.
 115:         retiring.clear()

 118: class _FactoryModelCapability:
 119:     def __init__(self, registry, factory, state_binding, generation):
 120:         self._registry = registry
 121:         self._factory = factory
 122:         self._state_binding = state_binding
 123:         self._generation = generation
 124:         self._active = True
 125:         self._used = False

 127:     def _factory_locked(self, factory):
 128:         registry = self._registry
 129:         registry._live_locked()
 130:         _require(registry._capability is self and self._active is True
 131:                  and self._generation is registry._generation and self._factory is factory,
 132:                  'factory_capability_identity')

 134:     def assert_factory_and_runtime(self, factory, owned_runtime_module):
 135:         with self._registry._lock:
 136:             self._factory_locked(factory)
 137:             _require(owned_runtime_module._RUNTIME is self._registry, 'owned_runtime_registry_identity')

 139:     def register_verified_model(self, factory, owned_runtime_module, model, observed_rows):
 140:         with self._registry._lock:
 141:             self.assert_factory_and_runtime(factory, owned_runtime_module)
 142:             _require(self._used is False and self._registry._lease is None,
 143:                      'model_registration_already_used')
 144:             _binding(_StateBindingProposal(self._state_binding.output_sha256,
 145:                                           self._state_binding.profile_binding_sha256, observed_rows))
 146:             _require(observed_rows == self._state_binding.tensor_digests,
 147:                      'verified_state_binding_mismatch')
 148:             _require(type(model) is factory._factory.PyanNet, 'fixed_model_type')
 149:             lease = _ModelRegistrationLease(self._registry, self, model, self._generation)
 150:             self._registry._lease = lease
 151:             self._used = True
 152:             return lease

 154:     def revoke(self, factory):
 155:         registry = self._registry
 156:         retiring = []
 157:         with registry._lock:
 158:             # Revocation remains available after generation closure. Identity is
 159:             # checked against the held capability, not a caller-provided token.
 160:             _require(registry._capability is self, 'factory_capability_identity')

 164:             if lease is not None and lease._capability is self:
 165:                 lease._active = False
 166:                 retiring.append(lease._model)
 167:                 lease._model = None

 169:             self._factory = None

 173: class _ModelRegistrationLease:
 174:     def __init__(self, registry, capability, model, generation):
 175:         self._registry = registry
 176:         self._capability = capability
 177:         self._model = model
 178:         self._generation = generation
 179:         self._active = True
 180: 
 181:     def assert_bound(self, factory, model):
 182:         with self._registry._lock:
 183:             self._capability._factory_locked(factory)
 184:             _require(self._registry._lease is self and self._active is True
 185:                      and self._model is model and self._generation is self._registry._generation,
 186:                      'model_lease_identity')

 189:     def revoke(self, factory):
